fullDescription: PredictAI Milling Machine Input is a bold editorial design system for industrial IoT and SaaS dashboards. It features high-contrast typography (Inter), a minimalist monochrome palette with vibrant blue accents, and a sophisticated motion-driven interface. Suitable for technical analytics, fintech, and advanced telemetry platforms, the style emphasizes metadata accents (monospace), 10vw hero text, and smooth cubic-bezier transitions. Key features include a custom interactive cursor, glassmorphism-lite input fields, and staggered reveal animations.
prompt:
## Resumo
A high-end editorial industrial dashboard design called 'PredictAI', focusing on precision, high-contrast typography, and smooth micro-interactions. It utilizes a 12-column grid to balance complex data input with large-scale visual references.

## Estilo Visual
### Typography
- **Headlines**: Font family 'Inter', weight 700, font-size clamp(3rem, 7vw, 10vw), line-height 0.9, letter-spacing -0.05em. Staggered reveal animations sliding up.
- **Body Text**: Font family 'Inter', size 18px, weight 400, color #525252 (light mode) or #737373 (dark mode).
- **Metadata**: Monospace font, size 11px, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.2em, color #737373.

### Color Palette
- **Backgrounds**: Light mode #FFFFFF, Dark mode #0A0A0A.
- **Accents**: Primary Blue #0052CC (hover: #0747A6), Success Green (Emerald 500).
- **Borders**: 1px solid with 5-10% opacity (black/5 for light, white/10 for dark).

### Interactive Elements
- **Custom Cursor**: A 32px circle, 1px border, mix-blend-mode: difference. Scales 2.5x on hover of interactive elements. Background white in light mode, border white in dark mode.
- **Animation Easing**: All transitions and keyframes use cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
- **Theme Transition**: 500ms duration for background-color and color changes.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation Bar
Fixed top bar, 100% width, mix-blend-mode: difference. Left: bold 'sd' logo. Center/Right: Monospace navigation links (01/Features, 02/How it works, etc.) with 10px size and 0.2em tracking. Far right: Theme toggle (Moon/Sun icon) and a '+' menu icon. 24px padding on sides.

### Hero Section
Top-aligned content. Small monospace 'Module' label at top-left. Headline 'MILLING MACHINE INPUT' split into two lines with 10vw font size. Staggered reveal animation where letters or lines slide up from hidden containers. Right side features a rounded status badge with a pulsing green dot and text 'SYSTEM STATUS: SAFE' in metadata font.

### Data Input Grid
7-column width container. 2x2 grid of input cards. Each card contains a monospace label top-left and a container box. Box: rounded 24px (3xl), light gray background (#F8F9FA) or dark background (#0A0A0A), containing a bold input value (24px) and a monospace unit label (CEL, RPM, NM) on the right. 1px subtle borders.

### Action Button Group
Two large rounded-full buttons at the bottom of the form. Primary: #0052CC background, white text, bold uppercase, subtle shadow-blue-500/20. Secondary: Light background/border, dark text. Hover states include 1.02x scale and opacity shifts.

### Visual Reference Card
5-column width container. Large image with 48px rounded corners. Image filter starts as 100% grayscale and transitions to full color on hover with a 1.05x scale zoom. Bottom-left overlay: Monospace 'Visual Reference' subtitle and a large bold uppercase 'ALPHA-7 SERIES' title over a dark gradient overlay.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Interactive Telemetry Input — A high-precision input field for technical data.
Padding 20px, rounded corners 24px, background #FFFFFF (light) or #0A0A0A (dark). Border 1px solid opacity 0.1. Layout: Flex-row between. Input: font-weight 700, size 24px, no border, no outline. Right side: Monospace unit label in #737373. Hover state changes border color to blue.

### Custom Blend Cursor — A system-wide custom cursor that interacts with the background.
Element: div id='custom-cursor'. Style: position: fixed, width/height: 32px, border-radius: 50%, mix-blend-mode: difference. Implementation: Use requestAnimationFrame for smooth 0.15 easing movement following mouse coordinates. Scale transition 0.5s on 'cursor-hover' class.

style.description: Editorial minimalist style with extreme typographic weight contrasts. Colors are primarily pure black (#000000), white (#FFFFFF), and deep blue (#0052CC) for actions. Typography uses Inter for headings (tight tracking) and monospace for technical metadata. Animations follow a signature 'reveal-up' motion with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
